basic_details.job_title: Janpad Panchayat Usoor Gram Rozgar Sahayak Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 23 Posts
basic_details.short_information: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

qualification.education_qualification: 12th pass (10th pass for ST and SC). Must be a resident of the gram panchayat concerned. For Bastar and Surguja divisions, the priority order is 12th pass, then 10th pass, then 8th pass.
qualification.details: Qualification: 12th pass (10th pass for ST and SC); Resident of the gram panchayat concerned; For Bastar and Surguja divisions, priority order of educational qualification: (1) 12th pass (2) 10th pass (3) 8th pass Experience: Not mandatory. Merit marks are given for experience in government rural development schemes on at least equal honorarium, and for six months' experience as Panchayat cum Data Entry Operator. Age limit: 18 to 40 years (as on 1 January 2026) | Other conditions: | Applicant must be a native resident of the gram panchayat concerned 100 percent disabled candidates not accepted as the posts involve field work Only permanent caste and residence certificates issued by the competent authority are accepted | Desirable: | One-year diploma or certificate (DCA/PGDCA/ITI COPA) from a recognised institution, or at least six months as Panchayat cum Data Entry Operator (15 merit marks) Experience in government rural development schemes on at least equal honorarium (up to 15 merit marks)

how_to_apply: Get the prescribed application form from the Janpad Panchayat Usoor notice board during office hours or from www.bijapur.gov.in.
Fill the form completely and attach self-attested copies of the required documents.
On the envelope write the post name, the category applied for and the gram panchayat name, plus the sender's name and correspondence address.
Submit in person or by registered post at the office of Janpad Panchayat Usoor between 10:00 and 5:30 office hours.
Applications must be received by 30/11/2026; later applications will not be considered.
important_instructions: Applicants working in government institutions must apply through proper channel with NOC All certificates and marksheets must be self-attested, otherwise the application will not be accepted Missing envelope details may lead to rejection District Collector takes the final decision on disputes in the recruitment process

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: 12th pass (10th pass for ST and SC); Resident of the gram panchayat concerned; For Bastar and Surguja divisions, priority order of educational qualification: (1) 12th pass (2) 10th pass (3) 8th pass Experience: Not mandatory. Merit marks are given for experience in government rural development schemes on at least equal honorarium, and for six months' experience as Panchayat cum Data Entry Operator. Age limit: 18 to 40 years (as on 1 January 2026) Other conditions: Applicant must be a native resident of the gram panchayat concerned 100 percent disabled candidates not accepted as the posts involve field work Only permanent caste and residence certificates issued by the competent authority are accepted Desirable: One-year diploma or certificate (DCA/PGDCA/ITI COPA) from a recognised institution, or at least six months as Panchayat cum Data Entry Operator (15 merit marks) Experience in government rural development schemes on at least equal honorarium (up to 15 merit marks)

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for Janpad Panchayat Usoor Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applicants earlier removed from any post by C.G. Ajeevika Samvardhan Samiti or any government department for indiscipline, misconduct, arbitrariness or irregularity Applicant who married before the minimum age prescribed for marriage

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Posts sanctioned from the date of joining up to 28.02.2027; extension may be decided by the appointing officer Contract appointment for 1 year; continuation for 1 year may be considered with consent of both parties Appointment fully temporary Either party may end the appointment with 01 month notice or 01 month pay in lieu No pension, gratuity or death benefits for contract service

content_sections.heading: How Will Janpad Panchayat Usoor Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Merit based on marks: 70 marks for marks obtained in minimum educational qualification Up to 15 marks for experience in government rural development schemes 15 marks for a one-year DCA/PGDCA/ITI COPA diploma or certificate, or six months as Panchayat cum Data Entry Operator Provisional list displayed on the Janpad Panchayat Usoor notice board for claims and objections 70 marks: weightage of marks obtained in minimum educational qualification 15 marks for experience: 05 marks for 06 months, then 1 mark per further 06 months, maximum 15 Equal marks: older candidate selected first If no eligible applicant from a gram panchayat, same-category candidate from the same Janpad Panchayat selected on merit

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Attested copies of educational qualification certificates Age certificate (copy of 10th marksheet) Copy of residence certificate Copy of caste certificate Copy of live employment registration NOC and experience certificate from appointing officer if currently working in a government rural development scheme post

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Janpad Panchayat Usoor Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Get the prescribed application form from the Janpad Panchayat Usoor notice board during office hours or from www.bijapur.gov.in. Fill the form completely and attach self-attested copies of the required documents. On the envelope write the post name, the category applied for and the gram panchayat name, plus the sender's name and correspondence address. Submit in person or by registered post at the office of Janpad Panchayat Usoor between 10:00 and 5:30 office hours. Applications must be received by 30/11/2026; later applications will not be considered.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Applicants working in government institutions must apply through proper channel with NOC All certificates and marksheets must be self-attested, otherwise the application will not be accepted Missing envelope details may lead to rejection District Collector takes the final decision on disputes in the recruitment process

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Janpad Panchayat Usoor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Janpad Panchayat Usoor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 23 vacancies for Gram Rozgar Sahayak.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for Janpad Panchayat Usoor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Pages 5-6 of this notice; also on the Janpad Panchayat Usoor notice board and www.bijapur.gov.in) and send it to Chief Executive Officer, Janpad Panchayat Usoor (Awapalli), District Bijapur (C.G.), by in person or by registered post, to reach by 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18 to 40 years (as on 1 January 2026).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Lump-sum monthly honorarium of Rs. 9960.00.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: 12th pass (10th pass for ST and SC). Must be a resident of the gram panchayat concerned. For Bastar and Surguja divisions, the priority order is 12th pass, then 10th pass, then 8th pass.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Applicant must be a native resident of the gram panchayat concerned. 100 percent disabled candidates not accepted as the posts involve field work. Only permanent caste and residence certificates issued by the competent authority are accepted.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applicants earlier removed from any post by C.G. Ajeevika Samvardhan Samiti or any government department for indiscipline, misconduct, arbitrariness or irregularity. Applicant who married before the minimum age prescribed for marriage.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Merit based on marks: 70 marks for marks obtained in minimum educational qualification. Up to 15 marks for experience in government rural development schemes. 15 marks for a one-year DCA/PGDCA/ITI COPA diploma or certificate, or six months as Panchayat cum Data Entry Operator. Provisional list displayed on the Janpad Panchayat Usoor notice board for claims and objections.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Posts sanctioned from the date of joining up to 28.02.2027; extension may be decided by the appointing officer. Contract appointment for 1 year; continuation for 1 year may be considered with consent of both parties. Appointment fully temporary.
